name: plumber-finder
description: Runs the three apps from the project root: backend (port 3300), frontend (port 3000), and admin (port 3001).

scripts.dev: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & npm --prefix admin run dev & wait
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
